messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed from inference runtime (model-runner pool) starting ~3123459900. Error pattern: segfaults / OOMs during batched generation. Pager triggered. :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Pager #7842 -> oncall Maria (maria). Severity: high. Notifying SRE and Eng.
maria: I'm on it. hopping onto bridge in 2m. can someone paste the quick summary?
jon: seeing gateway 502/504 in prod -> spike from 0.8% to 18% errors across region-east-1 since ~3123459800. CPU on model-runner hosts fine but kernel logs show OOM kills on runner processes.
lee: I pulled a node core dump. stack shows crash in q_attention.cu + large nvmem usage. attaching tail logs:
lee: ```
[2026-06-12T14:03:21Z] model-runner[pid=4521]: segfault at 0 ip q_attention+0x2b4
[2026-06-12T14:03:22Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4521 (model-runner)
[2026-06-12T14:03:22Z] model-runner[pid=4523]: eviction: killed token kvcache worker
```
maria: tx. can we isolate a rollback? any recent rollout to quantized-attn kernel?
jon: there was a canary of q-attention-2.1 rolled to 10% about an hour before. Canary metrics looked fine. Looks like memory footprint increased with longer sequences.
lee: yep, repro with seq_len 4096 + batch 8 on a test node pushes nvmem above threshold.
support-ops: Customer impact: a subset of requests are timing out / 502ing. CS reporting intermittent failures for integrations hitting the hosted API. No major account outages yet but visible errors on dashboards.
maria: mitigation plan: 1) reduce canary to 0% (rollback), 2) apply routing rule to send long sequence requests to non-quantized variant, 3) scale up hot spare pool to absorb traffic, 4) collect core dumps for kernel team.
jon: rolling rollback start: running deploy rollback for model-version q-attention-2.1 -> stable-attn-2.0 now (cmd pasted).
jon: ```bash
redwoodctl deploy rollback --model model-runner --from q-attention-2.1 --to stable-attn-2.0 --percentage 100
```
lee: routing rule applied: added prefix rule to route requests with token_count>2048 to stable-attn-2.0. live config: `routes.long_seq -> stable-attn-2.0`
lee: also triggered instance scale +2 in region-east-1, ETA ~60s.
maria: good. also spinning a non-quantized fallback pool for canary verification.
support-ops: Noted customer-facing banner drafted: "We’re investigating intermittent inference errors causing 5xx responses; mitigation in progress." Ping me for publish.
jon: rollback complete on 6 nodes, error rate dropping to 5% now.
lee: scale up completed. new pods healthy. core dumps uploaded to nexus (link). added crash collectors.
maria: still seeing a few OOM kills on older kernel nodes; triggering node drain for nodes with older drivers.
jon: can we hotpatch pod memory limit conservative values to avoid eviction while we continue investigation?
lee: applied temporary mem limits: `memory: 40Gi -> 48Gi` for model-runner pods. watch for paging.
maria: customer impact update: error rate back down to baseline ~0.9%. CS, prepare postmortem note and list affected request ranges.
support-ops: Will send initial incident email to affected customers with timeframe and mitigation steps.
lee: root cause hypothesis: q-attention-2.1 introduced a memory regression for long-sequence workloads under certain kernel/driver combinations leading to GPU memory growth and eventual segfault/OOM.
maria: next steps: 1) block q-attention-2.1 rollout, 2) reproduce locally with driver X.Y.Z, 3) add kvcache guards to limit memory growth, 4) bake extended canary with long-seq load. Assign to Jon/Lee for follow-ups.
jon: I'm taking reproduce + driver matrix. lee you take kvcache guard and hotfix plan. will sync in 30.
maria: thanks team. leaving the bridge once CS confirms banner. switching to monitoring watch. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Pager #7842 acknowledged by maria.
